optional.WebSearch: With no web grant, the run goes on and writes its result file. The result file records the web research as a gap, and the sources of its results have the type `model` or `default`. Give this grant only in a session whose input you trust, because it lets the run send words of the case to the search provider in a query.
optional.WebFetch: With no web grant, the run goes on and writes its result file. The result file records the web research as a gap, and the sources of its results have the type `model` or `default`. Give this grant only in a session whose input you trust, because it lets the run send data of the case to any address.
optional.mcp__<research server>: With no research server, or no grant for it, the gatherer uses `WebSearch` and `WebFetch`. Give this grant only in a session whose input you trust, because it lets the run send data of the case to the research server.
